dialogue.content: サカさん　こんばんわ本日はよろしくお願いいたします。クライアントのキャラクター設定のお願い希死念慮が強い　中学生をお願いします注意してみて頂きたいのが一つのことに対ししっかり受容と共感の言葉がまず先に入っていたかみて頂きたいですよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Saka-san, good evening. Thank you for your time today. For the client's character setting, please act as a middle school student with strong suicidal ideation. I'd like you to pay close attention to whether I first offer words of acceptance and empathy for each point. Thank you.

dialogue.content: お時間になったら始めさせて頂きます。
dialogue.English: We’ll begin when it’s time.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ相談員です本日はどのようなご相談で来られましたか？
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm a counselor. What brings you here today?

dialogue.content: 中2、男
dialogue.English: 8th grade, male.

dialogue.content: 返信有難うございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for your reply.

dialogue.content: 中学2年生の男の子ですね
dialogue.English: So you're an 8th-grade boy, is that right?

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 今日はどのようなお話があって来たのかな？
dialogue.English: What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: 生きてるのがつらい
dialogue.English: It’s painful to be alive.

dialogue.content: うんうん（うなずき）
dialogue.English: Mm-hm (nodding).

dialogue.content: どうして辛くなっちゃたか教えてもらえるかな？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what made it feel so hard?

dialogue.content: 学校がつらい
dialogue.English: School is hard.

dialogue.content: 学校辛いんだね。辛いときあるよね。
dialogue.English: So school is hard for you. It can be hard sometimes, can't it?

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: どんな時が辛かった？かな？お話しできるところからで大丈夫なので教えてもらえるかな？
dialogue.English: When did it feel hard? Could you tell me, starting with whatever you feel comfortable sharing?

dialogue.content: 友だちと合わない
dialogue.English: I don't get along with my friends.

dialogue.content: 教えてくれてありがとう
dialogue.English: Thank you for telling me.

dialogue.content: お友達と合わない子はどんな子かな？
dialogue.English: What kind of kid is the friend you don’t get along with?

dialogue.content: 背が高い
dialogue.English: He’s tall.

dialogue.content: 背が高いんだね。他にはあるかな？
dialogue.English: He’s tall, I see. Anything else?

dialogue.content: 友だちが多い
dialogue.English: He has a lot of friends.

dialogue.content: うんうん。（うなずき）そっかぁ。友達が多くて背が高いんだね。
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. (nodding) I see. So he’s tall and has a lot of friends.

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: そっかぁ。そっかぁ。その子とはどういうところが合わないと思うのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. I see. In what ways do you feel you don't get along with him?

dialogue.content: 色々売ってくる。レアだとかって。
dialogue.English: He keeps trying to sell me things, saying they're rare or something.

dialogue.content: 最初は買ったけど、もう無理
dialogue.English: I bought them at first, but I can't anymore.

dialogue.content: うんうん（うなずき）売ってくる？の？物を？かな？
dialogue.English: Mhmm (nods). He tries to sell you... things? Is that right?

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: 昔の硬貨とか、レアだって
dialogue.English: Old coins and stuff—he says they’re rare.

dialogue.content: そうだったんだ。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 無理に買わされれるのは嫌になるよね。
dialogue.English: Being pressured into buying things would feel awful, wouldn’t it.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: それは今も続いているのかな？
dialogue.English: Is that still going on now?

dialogue.content: お金もないし
dialogue.English: And I don't have any money.

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: うんうん。ちなみにどれくらいのお金で売ってくるの？
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. By the way, about how much is he trying to sell them for?

dialogue.content: 最初の硬貨は20万だった
dialogue.English: The first coin was 200,000 yen.

dialogue.content: わっ！そんなに！
dialogue.English: Wow! That much!

dialogue.content: 結構な額の値段だよね。それ買ったの？買わされたの？
dialogue.English: That’s quite a sum. Did you buy it, or were you pressured into buying it?

dialogue.content: ？買った
dialogue.English: ? I bought it.

dialogue.content: ごめんね。上手く伝えられてなかったね最初は２０万の硬貨を売られてサカくんはどうしたの？かなって？
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, I didn't phrase that well. When he first offered you the 200,000 yen coin, what did you do, Saka-kun?

dialogue.content: 買ったよ
dialogue.English: I bought it.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。それはサカくんが興味があって買ったのかな？
dialogue.English: I see. Did you buy it because you were interested, Saka-kun?

dialogue.content: そうだね
dialogue.English: I guess so.

dialogue.content: 値段は驚いたけど、レアだって言うし投資にもなるって聞いたから、いいかなって
dialogue.English: I was surprised by the price, but he said it was rare and I heard it could be an investment, so I thought it might be okay.

dialogue.content: そっかぁ。そうだったんだね未来の自分のための財産になるかもしれないしね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that’s how it was—you thought it might become an asset for your future self.

dialogue.content: そう話しを聞いたら買わずにはいられなくなるかもしれないね。
dialogue.English: Hearing it put that way, it might be hard to resist buying it.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。それからすすめられる頻度が増えてったて感じかな？
dialogue.English: I see. And after that, did he start pushing them on you more often?

dialogue.content: そう
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 次々来て、どうしたらいいか分からなくなった
dialogue.English: They kept coming one after another, and I didn’t know what to do.

dialogue.content: うんうん。それはお金もかかるものだからどうしたらいいかわからなくなるよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. Since it costs money, it’s natural to feel unsure about what to do.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: サカくんはどうしたらいいかは考えたことはあるかな？例えばキッパリ断るとかそれ以外でも何でも何かあるかな？
dialogue.English: Have you thought about what you could do, Saka-kun? For example, firmly refusing, or anything else?

dialogue.content: 友だちだから、断りづらい
dialogue.English: He's a friend, so it's hard to say no.

dialogue.content: うんうん身近にいる友達だと余計に断りづらくなるよねじゃあその子が嫌いとかではなくて友達だから断りづらいっていうことかな？
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. It's especially hard to refuse when it's a close friend, isn't it? So, it's not that you dislike him, but rather that it's hard to say no because he's your friend—is that right?

dialogue.content: 友だちだから
dialogue.English: Because he's my friend.

dialogue.content: サカくんはとっても友達思いなんだね。
dialogue.English: You're a very thoughtful friend, Saka-kun.

dialogue.content: ん、どうだろ
dialogue.English: Hmm, I don't know about that.

dialogue.content: 本当にどうでもいい相手であればキッパリ断っていると思うよ。そうではないということはお友達のことを考えていることなんじゃないかな？
dialogue.English: I think if you didn't care about him at all, you would have refused firmly. The fact that you haven't means you're thinking about your friend, don't you think?

dialogue.content: よく分からない
dialogue.English: I don’t really know.

dialogue.content: うんうん。そのお友達との今の状況をどうしていくか考えてるとよくわからなくなるよね
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. It's understandable to feel unsure when you're thinking about how to handle the current situation with your friend.

dialogue.content: 今の状況をサカくんはどうしたいか考えは何かあるかな？
dialogue.English: Do you have any thoughts on what you'd like to do about the current situation, Saka-kun?

dialogue.content: 逃げ出したい
dialogue.English: I want to run away.

dialogue.content: 逃げたくなるよね。
dialogue.English: It makes sense you’d want to run away.

dialogue.content: うん
dialogue.English: Yeah.

dialogue.content: （ロールプレイはお時間がここまでになりますが途中ですが終了した方がよろしいでしょうか？）
dialogue.English: (This is all the time we have for the role-play. Shall we end it here, even though we're in the middle?)

dialogue.content: (終了していいですよ)
dialogue.English: (Yes, it's fine to end.)

dialogue.content: （畏まりました）
dialogue.English: (Understood.)

dialogue.content: 本日はありがとございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much for today.

dialogue.content: ロールプレイを終了いたします
dialogue.English: We will now end the role-play.
